Elena P: quick sync  Draft internal note ready for 2.16.1. aiming to post at 18:30 PT. can someone verify pin wording and rollback bullets?
Vikram S: looks good. add model artifact SHAs and the exact rbinctl pin command.
Elena P: done in PR, will paste final snippet here shortly.
deploy-bot: preflight check: staging smoke OK, snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1725 created.
oncall-jun: i'll be on standby 18:00-19:30. i want an explicit kill-switch line in the note.
Vikram S: added: "Kill-switch: rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0 (oncall only)" and metrics to watch: token_latency.p95, inference.errors/5m.
Elena P: rollback criteria (short): error rate >=2% over 5m OR P95 latency +45% OR 2+ smoke failures -> reduce canary to 0% and notify #eng-oncall; escalate to SEV if 2 conditions met. full wording in runbook.
Vikram S: ops needs final approved copy by 17:30 to feed deploybot.
Elena P: will drop final by 17:20. one-liner for deploybot: "Deploy 2.16.1: canary 5% for 20m -> 25% for 20m -> full. rollback rules in internal note."
oncall-jun: ack, standby and ready to trigger kill-switch if thresholds hit.
Elena P: thanks team. checklist: (1) final copy by 17:20, (2) SHAs locked in PR, (3) oncall confirmed, (4) deploybot schedule set. :thumbsup:
